units.source_text: “我突然双手抱住K的头，稍稍抬起，想看看K死后的面容。

en.t: I suddenly held K's head in both hands, lifted it slightly, and tried to see his face after death.

units.source_text: 可是，当我从下面去看他那朝下的面孔时，立刻放开了手。

en.t: But when I looked up from below at his downward-turned face, I immediately let go.

units.source_text: 不仅是害怕，还感觉他的头异常沉重。

en.t: It was not only fear; his head also felt strangely heavy.

units.source_text: 我俯看着刚才触摸到的他那冰冷的耳朵和他那头一如平时的浓密头发。

en.t: I looked down at the cold ear I had just touched and at his thick hair, unchanged from usual.

units.source_text: 我一点也没想哭，只是觉得恐怖。

en.t: I did not feel like crying at all; I felt only terror.

units.source_text: 这种恐怖的感觉，不仅仅是眼前的情景刺激感官而产生的单纯的恐怖，

en.t: This feeling of terror was not merely the simple terror produced when the scene before my eyes stimulated my senses,

units.source_text: 我深深预感到了，这位身体突然变得冰冷的朋友所暗示的命运的恐怖。

en.t: I deeply sensed the terror of the fate hinted at by this friend whose body had suddenly grown cold.

units.source_text: 我的脑子里一片空白，又返回自己房中，

en.t: With my mind completely blank, I returned to my own room,

units.source_text: 在这间八叠大的屋子里转悠起来，

en.t: and began pacing around the eight-mat room,

units.source_text: 大概是我的头脑命令自己姑且这样瞎转悠一阵子的。

en.t: as though my mind had ordered me to keep moving aimlessly like that for the time being.

units.source_text: 我觉得必须做什么，同时又觉得自己什么也做不了，

en.t: I felt that I had to do something, and at the same time I felt that I could do nothing at all,

units.source_text: 所以只能在这屋子里转圈，犹如关在笼子里的熊那样无计可施。

en.t: so I could only circle around the room, helpless like a bear shut in a cage.

units.source_text: 我几次想到里面去叫醒夫人，

en.t: Several times I thought of going inside to wake the lady of the house,

units.source_text: 可是不应该让女人看到这可怕情景的念头又立刻阻止了我。

en.t: but the thought that I should not let a woman see this dreadful scene immediately stopped me.

units.source_text: 夫人还好说，万万不可惊吓到小姐，

en.t: The lady might still be one thing, but I absolutely could not frighten the young mistress,

units.source_text: 这一强烈的意志阻止了我。

en.t: and that strong resolve held me back.
And so I began pacing in circles again.
